title: Panel commands not working consistently on Wear OS on Galaxy Watch 6 classic
symptom: Tile commands on Wear OS do not work consistently when not using an AAPS supplied watchface. They work for a while then stop responding to the phone app. Force closing and restarting the watch app resumes function temporarily. Complications continue working even when panels no longer are.
cause: Android kills apps in the background, causing the panel and phone to stop communicating after inactivity.
evidence_quote: yes, android kills apps on background. Currently there is no solution
